headline: Hackers are using AI to automate cyberattacks
standfirst: Microsoft warns that state-backed groups are using new AI tools to speed up system

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Hackers in China and North Korea are using an AI tool called ARTEX to infiltrate tech systems.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: This framework automates common attack techniques that humans used to perform manually.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: The automation is so efficient that it can potentially bypass weak defenses in just minutes.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Security teams will need to update their defenses to counter these faster, automated threats.

caption:
Microsoft has identified state-backed hackers using the ARTEX AI tool for cyberattacks.

The report highlights an 'agentic offensive framework' that allows attackers to scale their efforts. By automating familiar techniques, these groups can find and exploit vulnerabilities much faster than before.
